title: Sparse 12-Particle 270-Degree Arc Interpolation
intuition: Tests whether a generator paired with just 12 zero-sigma discrete particles on a 270-degree circular arc (R=2.0) maps unseen latent k-NN chords (t = 0.25, 0.5, 0.75) smoothly along the curved arc (>= 22/32 arc bins, interp_hq >= 0.80, midpoint_novelty >= 0.20) instead of snapping to endpoints or cutting chords across dead space.
failure_mode: Discrete prototype atlases often act like piecewise-constant lookup tables (Voronoi snapping -> low novelty) or interpolate linearly across empty interior space (low interp_hq).
protocol_notes: Tier-1 stretch task and Four Laws Adherence Law 1 anchor; zero-sigma ParticlePrior exception.
